articles.author: TV News
articles.description:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 just got the green light at Anime Expo 2025, complete with its first poster visual and a surprise cameo from director Hiroyuki Imaishi. Voice stars Emi Lo (Lucy) and Zach Aguilar (David) joined writer/producer Bartosz Sztybor (who cheekily quipped “David’s dead” and admitted he wanted to make everyone even sadder) on a panel hosted by TheAnimeMan, where they also blasted “I Really Want to Stay At Your House” on repeat.  
Set for another 10-episode dive into Night City—this time billed as “a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge”—the sequel is helmed by Kai Ikarashi (Episode 6 of the original). A teaser trailer dropped July 5, and CD Projekt Red’s Michał Nowakowski confirms it’ll land on Netflix in due time, so get ready for more cybernetic heartbreak.
articles.title: 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners' Season 2 Announced

articles.author: TV News
articles.description:
Craig Robinson shocked fans by dropping the mic on his comedy career—via an Instagram video, the Office alum (best known as Darryl Philbin) revealed he’s officially retiring from stand-up and sketch, teasing “something huge” on the horizon. He hinted he’s pivoting to a small-business venture, confessing he’s already hit “a few bumps in the road” and calling on fellow entrepreneurs for tips.
His post racked up love from celeb buddies—Kate Flannery cheered him on, Howie Mandel cracked a dance joke, Arsenio Hall dropped a lyrical pun, and David Arquette backed Robinson’s musical chops (he’s played bass with The Nasty Delicious since ’07). Whatever comes next, it’s clear Robinson has a hype squad ready to see him soar.
articles.title: Craig Robinson Makes Surprise Announcement: “I'm Officially Quitting Comedy”

articles.author: TV News
articles.description:
The Tiny Chef Show was canned by Nickelodeon in June, but a tear-jerking clip of Tiny Chef crying over the phone went super-viral and sparked a fan-powered crowdfunding blitz. Supporters flooded donations and joined the “Fan Cwub,” raising enough cash to keep production rolling—though no new TV deal is official yet.
In a celebratory Instagram post, the creators declared “you all have SAVED TINY CHEF!” and are gearing up to film more adventures. Whether we’ll see full episodes or bite-size web clips remains up in the air, but this once-obscure toon is now a global fave on the back of kindness, creativity and internet magic.
articles.title: 'Tiny Chef Show' “saved” after viral cancellation and fundraising efforts as creators confirm return

articles.author: AI News
articles.description:
A Russia-aligned disinfo ring known as Operation Overload (aka Matryoshka or Storm-1679) has gone all-in on free, consumer-grade AI tools to crank out hundreds more fake images, videos, QR codes and phony websites—jumping from 230 unique pieces of content last year to 587 in just eight months. By leaning on off-the-shelf text-to-image generators (like Flux AI) and AI voice-cloners, they’re churning out pro-Russian narratives—especially about Ukraine and immigration—at scale to sow division around global elections.
The campaign’s multimedia blitz lives everywhere from 600+ Telegram channels to bot armies on X and Bluesky—and even popped up on TikTok before the platform pulled the accounts. Researchers warn this “content amalgamation” tactic, powered by free AI, marks a big shift toward lightning-fast, multilingual propaganda that’s only going to get harder to track.
articles.title: A Pro-Russia Disinformation Campaign Is Using Free AI Tools to Fuel a ‘Content Explosion'

Nowhere to be found



Without clear, updated documentation:
Features are misunderstood
Bugs take longer to fix

Delivery slows down

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Romero Games, the Irish outfit founded by John and Brenda Romero, has apparently shut its doors after Microsoft abruptly pulled funding for their unannounced Unreal Engine 5 shooter. Over 100 staffers lost their jobs with zero warning—one anonymous team member described it as “a big shock.” While there’s talk of hunting down a new publisher, for now both the project and the studio sit in limbo.
This closure is just the latest fallout from Microsoft’s sweeping cuts—up to 9,000 roles wiped out, the Perfect Dark reboot and Rare’s Everwild canceled, The Initiative and parts of ZeniMax shuttered, and senior talent exiting left and right. The Xbox world is reeling, and Romero Games has become one of its most high-profile casualties.
articles.title: Romero Games now ‘completely closed' following Microsoft cuts, it's claimed

Helldivers 2 remains a PC and PlayStation exclusive for now, complete with crossplay support—but Xbox Game Pass won’t be one of its platforms. Sorry, no free ride here.
